description: This file defines an internal sealed record 'AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry' that models a grain activation in an ADONET grain directory within the Orleans framework. It includes constructors, conversion methods to and from 'GrainAddress', and methods handling null argument validation.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry
classes.description: A record representing a grain activation, with methods to convert to/from GrainAddress.

methods.name: ToGrainAddress
methods.description: Converts the record to a GrainAddress object.

methods.name: FromGrainAddress
methods.description: Creates an AdoNetGrainDirectoryEntry from a provided GrainAddress.
